parts.text: This question is about compounds of phosphorus.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Gaseous phosphorus( V ) chloride decomposes into gaseous phosphorus( III ) chloride and gaseous chlorine. When the three gases are present in a closed container the system reaches equilibrium. PC l 5 (g) PC l 3 (g) + C l 2 (g)

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Complete the table using only the words increases , decreases or no change . effect on the rate of the forward reaction effect on the equilibrium yield (PC l 3 (g) and C l 2 (g)) increasing the temperature increases decreasing the pressure adding a catalyst no change [4]

ms.label: 4(a)(i)
ms.text:
M1 increases (1)
M2 decreases (1)
M3 increases (1)
M4 increases (1)

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The table shows that when the temperature increases, the equilibrium yields of PC l 3 (g) and C l 2 (g) increase. State what conclusion can be made from this. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Complete the dot-and-cross diagram to show the electron arrangement in a molecule of phosphorus( III ) chloride, PC l 3 . Show outer shell electrons only. [2]

ms.label: 4(b)
ms.text:
M1 3 dot and cross bonding pairs (1)
M2 All lone pairs correct.
All octets should be complete AND dots and crosses should be different on P and all Cl (1)

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Phosphorus oxychloride has the formula POC l 3 . Phosphorus oxychloride is the only product of the reaction between phosphorus( V ) chloride, PC l 5 , and phosphorus( V ) oxide, P 4 O 10 . Write a chemical equation for the reaction between phosphorus( V ) chloride and phosphorus( V ) oxide. .............................................................................................................................................. [2]

ms.label: 4(c)
ms.text:
P4O10 + 6PCl5 → 10POCl3
M1 all formula correct and on the correct sides of the arrow (1)
M2 equation fully correct (1)

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Compound X has the following composition by mass. H, 3.66%; P, 37.80%; O, 58.54% Calculate the empirical formula of compound X . empirical formula = .............................. [2]

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Compound Y has the empirical formula H 3 PO 4 and a relative molecular mass of 98. Deduce the molecular formula of compound Y . molecular formula = .............................. [1]
